formula: base if custom_weekly_payment_days==0 else base * custom_weekly_payment_days /30
name: Basic
Income Tax(BATL)

formula:
int(
    (
        int(
            (
                BP
                + SW
                + VDA
                - custom_time_loss_in_hours_deduction
                + custom_employee_reimbursement_wages
                - custom_reimbursement_hra_amount
            ) + 0.5
        ) * (custom_voluntary_pf_percentage / 100)
    ) + 0.5
) if BP > 0 else 0
name: Voluntary PF
Canteen Subsidy

formula:
(
    BP + SW + VDA + custom_subsistence_allowance - custom_subsistence_hra
    - round(custom_time_loss_in_hours_deduction)
    + round(custom_employee_reimbursement_wages)
    - round(custom_reimbursement_hra_amount)
)* 0.12 if BP >0 or custom_subsistence_allowance > 0 else 0
name: Employee PF
